KZ.FINALIZATION_HELP: Checks run after the download finishes, before the file is placed in its destination. Each one reads the whole file, which can take minutes on large files and hard disks. When the destination is on the same disk as the download, the file is never copied or read twice.
KZ.FINALIZATION_HASH_DOWNLOAD_INFO: Reads the downloaded file once to compute its SHA-256. It is recorded and used to detect a file that changed if finalization is interrupted and resumed. When a copy to another disk is needed, the hash is computed during the copy, without an extra read.
KZ.FINALIZATION_VERIFY_COPY: Verify the copy to another disk
KZ.FINALIZATION_VERIFY_COPY_INFO: Only applies when the destination is on another disk and the file has to be copied. Reads the copy again and compares it with the downloaded file, to catch a copy damaged by a disk or cable problem.
KZ.FINALIZATION_VERIFY_PLACED_INFO: Hashes the file under its final name and compares it with the downloaded file. A file already verified in this finalization is not read again, so on the same disk this costs nothing extra.
KZ.FINALIZATION_NONE_WARNING: With every check off, the file content is not verified; only its size and identity are.
KZ.FINALIZATION_STEP_PLACING: Placing the file in its destination
KZ.FINALIZATION_EXPLAIN: The download finished. The file is being checked and moved to its destination; the checks can be changed in Settings → Storage.
KZ.DISK_ACTIVITY_CGROUP_V2_MISSING: Disk activity is unavailable: it requires cgroup v2 (Docker 20.10 or newer on a host with cgroup v2). Check with docker info --format '{{.CgroupVersion}}'.
KZ.DISK_ACTIVITY_NO_BLOCK_STATS: Disk activity is not available for this storage (network share, ZFS or an unidentified device).
KZ.AUTO_SAVE_INTERVAL_RESTART_NOTICE: Takes effect only after aria2 restarts.
KZ.ARIA2_RESTART_PENDING: aria2 is running with a control-file save interval of {{running}} s; restart aria2 to apply {{saved}} s.
KZ.ARIA2_RESTART_FAILED: aria2 did not come back after the restart. Try again or restart the container.
KZ.ARIA2_RESTART_CONFIRM: Downloads in progress pause for a few seconds and resume where they were. Restart aria2 now?
KZ.ARIA2_RESTART_HELP: Restarts only the download engine. Progress is saved and transfers resume.
KZ.CONCURRENCY_INFO: How many downloads aria2 transfers at the same time. Others wait in the queue.
KZ.DEBRID_CONCURRENCY_INFO: Limit of simultaneous downloads from the same debrid service. Some providers throttle or block accounts with too many parallel transfers.
KZ.CONNECTIONS_INFO: Parallel connections opened for each file. More connections usually reach higher speeds, but some servers limit or penalize them. Maximum 16.
KZ.MIN_SPLIT_INFO: aria2 only splits a file into another connection when each part is at least this big. Smaller values use more connections on small files.
KZ.LOWEST_SPEED_INFO: Closes a connection whose speed stays below this value. Useful against stuck connections, but a closed connection is not replaced.
KZ.DISK_CACHE_INFO: Memory aria2 uses to group writes before sending them to disk. Larger values reduce disk work on slow disks at the cost of RAM. 0 disables it.
KZ.TIMEOUT_INFO: Seconds without an answer from the server before a connection is considered failed and retried.
KZ.MAX_TRIES_INFO: How many times aria2 retries a failing download before giving up. 0 retries forever.
KZ.RETRY_WAIT_INFO: Seconds aria2 waits before retrying a failed connection. 0 retries immediately.
KZ.MAX_FILE_NOT_FOUND_INFO: How many "file not found" answers aria2 accepts before failing the download. Debrid links sometimes return it briefly.
KZ.ALLOCATION_INFO: How the file space is reserved before downloading. FALLOC is instant on Linux file systems that support it; PREALLOC writes zeros and can take minutes on large files; NONE reserves nothing.
KZ.IPV6_INFO: Allows aria2 to connect over IPv6. Disable it if your network has broken IPv6 and downloads stall at the start.
KZ.AUTO_SAVE_INTERVAL_INFO: How often aria2 saves its control file while downloading. Each save flushes pending writes to disk and can freeze aria2 for seconds on slow disks. Larger values freeze less often, but after a crash or power loss aria2 downloads again everything since the last save. Clean stops always save. 0 saves only when stopping. Requires an aria2 restart.
KZ.ALLOCATION_FALLBACK: Allocation automatically switched to prealloc for filesystem compatibility.
KZ.ARIA2_STORAGE_FAILED: aria2 encountered a storage error. Check free space, folder permissions and the allocation mode.
KZ.ARIA2_SPEED_LIMIT: The download fell below the configured minimum speed. Check lowest-speed-limit in the transfer settings.
KZ.ARIA2_NETWORK_FAILED: The aria2 connection failed. Check the network, DNS and timeout in the transfer settings.
KZ.ADDON_HTTP_REQUIRED: This historical request requires torrent resolution. Select a new release with an HTTP link supplied by the search addon.
KZ.HTTP_LINK_FAILED: The HTTP link server refused or interrupted the transfer. Reload releases to obtain a current link and try again.
KZ.ARIA2_TRANSFER_FAILED: aria2 could not complete the transfer. Check the provider and try again.
KZ.DEBRID_CONCURRENCY: Concurrent downloads on the same debrid
KZ.DEBRID_CONCURRENCY_WARNING: Concurrent downloads on the same debrid may violate the provider's policy. Check your account limits before increasing this value.
KZ.CONNECTIONS_HELP: Sets max-connection-per-server and split to the same value, up to 16 connections.
KZ.LOWEST_SPEED_ENABLED: Require a minimum speed per connection
KZ.LOWEST_SPEED_ENABLED_HINT: Connections slower than the minimum are closed and are not replaced, so a download can end up with fewer connections.

KZ.ADDON_HELP: Use the complete URL of a configured addon, such as AIOStreams, Torrentio or Comet, that provides HTTP download links. Secret URLs are hidden. Leave the URL blank to keep it when editing.
KZ.NEW_REQUESTS_ONLY: Changes affect new requests. Existing requests keep their naming snapshot and existing files stay in place.
KZ.PLACEHOLDERS: Available folder fields {title}, {year}, {season}, {episode}, {episodeTitle}, {providerId}. Bracketed segments are optional. {providerId} includes the identifier brackets. Use {season:02} for season padding.
KZ.SAMPLE_EXTENSION: This path uses illustrative metadata and an example original filename.

KZ.METADATA_EXAMPLES: We recommend AIOMetadata for titles, posters and episodes. Cinemeta is another option, with its manifest at https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/manifest.json.
KZ.SEARCH_EXAMPLES: We recommend AIOStreams to bring your search sources together. Other examples include Torrentio and Comet. Paste the link generated after configuring the addon.
KZ.ADDON_NAME_HELP: Optional. Leave empty to use the name supplied by the manifest.
KZ.MANIFEST_URL_HELP: Paste the addon link, for example https://your-addon.example/your-configuration/manifest.json. stremio:// links are also supported. The /manifest.json suffix is added automatically.
KZ.ADDON_INVALID_URL: Enter a valid HTTP, HTTPS or stremio:// addon link.
KZ.ADDON_UNAVAILABLE: Could not connect to the addon. Check that its server is available and reachable from the backend.
KZ.ADDON_TIMEOUT: The addon took too long to respond. Try again or check its server.
KZ.ADDON_UNAUTHORIZED: The addon denied access. Generate a new link in its configuration and try again.
KZ.ADDON_NOT_FOUND: The manifest was not found. Check the link generated in the addon configuration.
KZ.ADDON_HTTP_ERROR: The addon server returned an error. Check its availability and try again.
KZ.ADDON_INVALID_MANIFEST: The link returned an invalid manifest. Copy the installation link generated by the addon.
KZ.ADDON_MISSING_CATALOG: This addon manifest does not declare the "catalog" resource required for metadata addons. Use a metadata addon such as AIOMetadata or Cinemeta, or enable catalogs in its configuration.
KZ.ADDON_MISSING_META: This addon manifest does not declare the "meta" resource required for metadata addons. Use a metadata addon such as AIOMetadata or Cinemeta, or enable metadata in its configuration.
KZ.ADDON_MISSING_CATALOG_META: This addon manifest declares neither the "catalog" nor the "meta" resource required for metadata addons. Use a metadata addon such as AIOMetadata or Cinemeta.
KZ.ADDON_MISSING_STREAM: This addon manifest does not declare the "stream" resource required for search addons. Use a stream addon such as AIOStreams, Torrentio or Comet.
KZ.ADDON_SEARCH_REQUIRED: Add and enable at least one search addon.
